spans.text: Evriwan i garem rait lo laef, friidom en sekuriti blo olketa.
Evriwan i garem rait en friidom lo tingting blo olketa seleva en lo siosi blo olketa.
Evriwan i garem rait fo waka, fo siusim wanem kaen waka nao olketa i laek fo duim en wanem kaen samting nao lo waka ples blo olketa en fo mekem olketa garem protecsen againstim kaen no garem waka.
Evriwan i garem rait fo tekem pei wea fittim waka olketa i duim.

folded.object: kasem taem wea olketa savve maret

spans.text: Olketa man en mere wea kasem taem wea olketa savve maret, bae savve maretem eniwan blo difren ples, kantre or siosi en garem famili.

folded.object: go lo kot lo eni kriminol samting

spans.text: Eni wan wea go lo kot lo eni kriminol samting, olketa sapos fo garem fea hiaring.

spans.text: Evri groups wea pat blo gavman or nomoa mas waka fo findim beta wei fo mekem pipol evriwea lo wol ya kam fo luk savve lo olketa hiuman raits ya.
Lo loa, evri wan wea olketa chargim wittim eni kriminol samting, kot mas lukim olketa olsem olketa inocen kasem taem olketa provim dat olketa guilti.

folded.id: evri wan|i|garem rait lo eniwea fo loa luk savve lo olketa

folded.object: garem rait lo eniwea fo loa luk savve lo olketa

spans.text: Evri wan i garem rait lo eniwea fo loa luk savve lo olketa.
Evri wan i frii fo som en talem wanem tingting blo olketa.

folded.id: evriwan|i|garem rait lo laef
folded.subject: Evriwan
folded.object: garem rait lo laef

spans.text: Evriwan i garem rait lo laef, friidom en sekuriti blo olketa.
Evriwan i garem rait en friidom lo tingting blo olketa seleva en lo siosi blo olketa.
Evriwan i garem rait fo waka, fo siusim wanem kaen waka nao olketa i laek fo duim en wanem kaen samting nao lo waka ples blo olketa en fo mekem olketa garem protecsen againstim kaen no garem waka.
Evriwan i garem rait fo tekem pei wea fittim waka olketa i duim.

spans.text: Evriwan olketa garem rait fo go lo olketa nara kantre sapos olketa kasem trabol lo kantre blo olketa.

spans.text: No eni wan sapos fo guilti lo eni niu loa sapos kriminol samting or toktok olketa duim i lo taem wea olketa loa ya olketa no wakem yeti.

No eni man savve stopem nara wan fo memba lo eni kantre, lo sem taem olketa hard fo stopem tu sapos olketa laek memba lo eni niu kantre.

folded.object: blo olketa en wanem olketa believim

spans.text: Lo dis fala wol, olketa pipol sapos fo garem friidom fo tallem tingting blo olketa en wanem olketa believim.

folded.subject: garem rait
folded.object: olketa bae frii fo mekem eni asembli or asociasen

spans.text: Evriwan olketa garem rait wea olketa bae frii fo mekem eni asembli or asociasen.

folded.object: loa fo loa luk aftam olketa

folded.subject: hemi meanim
folded.object: if man laek changim siosi or belif blo hem

folded.subject: hemi tallem
folded.object: no eni wan sapos fo go disturbim olketa famili

spans.text: Lo loa hemi tallem dat no eni wan sapos fo go disturbim olketa famili, haus or olketa privet samting blo nara man en no eni man sapos fo trae spoilem nara man.

folded.subject: impoten tumas
folded.object: nomata wanem hemi hapen

spans.text: Hemi impoten tumas dat nomata wanem hemi hapen, loa hemi mas mek sua dat hemi kipim strong disfala hiuman raits.

folded.id: kaen problem|wea|man no luk savve lo raits wea loa i givim lo evri wan
folded.subject: kaen problem
folded.object: man no luk savve lo raits wea loa i givim lo evri wan

spans.text: Olketa fo helpim evriwan fo stretem bak kaen problem wea man no luk savve lo raits wea loa i givim lo evri wan.

folded.id: kaen samting|wea|sapos fo no kasem eniwan
folded.subject: kaen samting
folded.object: sapos fo no kasem eniwan

spans.text: No eni wan bae hemi sapos fo kasem kaen wea olketa i arrestim or tekem fo no eni gud rison, forcim fo lusim ples blo hem, hemi kaen samting wea sapos fo no kasem eniwan.
Maret mas samting wea man en mere evriwan mas laek fo duim en no eniwan forcim.

folded.id: kaen trabol|wea|hemi go againstim tingting blo united nations or hemi kriminol samting
folded.subject: kaen trabol
folded.object: hemi go againstim tingting blo United Nations or hemi kriminol samting

spans.text: Dis fala rait bae hemi hard fo waka sapos olketa kaen trabol wea hemi go againstim tingting blo United Nations or hemi kriminol samting.

folded.id: kantre|or|siosi en garem famili
folded.subject: kantre
folded.object: siosi en garem famili

spans.text: Olketa man en mere wea kasem taem wea olketa savve maret, bae savve maretem eniwan blo difren ples, kantre or siosi en garem famili.

folded.subject: kaonsels olketa
folded.object: stap fo helpim evriwan stretem kaen problems wea pipol luk daonim or tritim no gud nara fala

spans.text: Olketa nasinol kaonsels olketa i stap fo helpim evriwan stretem kaen problems wea pipol luk daonim or tritim no gud nara fala.
Evriwan i garem rait fo waka, fo siusim wanem kaen waka nao olketa i laek fo duim en wanem kaen samting nao lo waka ples blo olketa en fo mekem olketa garem protecsen againstim kaen no garem waka.

folded.id: kasem kaen|wea|olketa i arrestim or tekem fo no eni gud rison
folded.subject: kasem kaen
folded.object: olketa i arrestim or tekem fo no eni gud rison

spans.text: No eni wan bae hemi sapos fo kasem kaen wea olketa i arrestim or tekem fo no eni gud rison, forcim fo lusim ples blo hem, hemi kaen samting wea sapos fo no kasem eniwan.

folded.id: laek lukaotim|or|tekem or givim enikaen infomesin lo eni wei en eni wea hemi laek fo duim
folded.subject: laek lukaotim
folded.object: tekem or givim enikaen infomesin lo eni wei en eni wea hemi laek fo duim

spans.text: Dis fala rait hemi coverim sapos man laek lukaotim or tekem or givim enikaen infomesin lo eni wei en eni wea hemi laek fo duim.

folded.id: luk savve|lo|digniti en ikwol raits blo evri memba blo hiuman famili
folded.subject: luk savve
folded.object: digniti en ikwol raits blo evri memba blo hiuman famili

spans.text: Taem umi kam fo luk savve lo digniti en ikwol raits blo evri memba blo hiuman famili.
Taem pipol no luk savve lo dis fala hiuman raits, risalt blo hem nao pipol i no luk savve lo gud wei en rabis wei.

folded.id: maeni fo|tingting|en olketa sapos fo treatim isada wittim spirit blo bradahood
folded.subject: maeni fo
folded.object: en olketa sapos fo treatim isada wittim spirit blo bradahood

spans.text: Olketa evriwan olketa garem maeni fo tingting en olketa sapos fo treatim isada wittim spirit blo bradahood.

folded.id: man|or|mere from difren kantre
folded.subject: man
folded.object: mere from difren kantre

spans.text: Evri wan nomata olketa garem difren kala, langus, siosi, status, man or mere from difren kantre, evri wan stil garem rait en friidom wea hemi lo disfala Declarason, en nomata man hemi kam from kantre wea garem difren politiks or status lo nara kantre, or hemi indipenden or nomoa, hemi stil garem olketa raits en friidom ya.

folded.id: mek sua|dat|fo luk daonim or tritim no gud nara man bikos lo rabis tingting hemi brekim disfala declarason
folded.subject: mek sua
folded.object: fo luk daonim or tritim no gud nara man bikos lo rabis tingting hemi brekim disfala Declarason

spans.text: Dis fala loa hemi mek sua dat fo luk daonim or tritim no gud nara man bikos lo rabis tingting hemi brekim disfala Declarason.

folded.id: mek sua|dat|hemi kipim strong disfala hiuman raits
folded.subject: mek sua
folded.object: hemi kipim strong disfala hiuman raits

spans.text: Hemi impoten tumas dat nomata wanem hemi hapen, loa hemi mas mek sua dat hemi kipim strong disfala hiuman raits.

folded.subject: nao pipol
folded.object: no luk savve lo gud wei en rabis wei

spans.text: Taem pipol no luk savve lo dis fala hiuman raits, risalt blo hem nao pipol i no luk savve lo gud wei en rabis wei.

folded.id: nara help|wea|olketa bae needim
folded.subject: nara help
folded.object: olketa bae needim

spans.text: Evriwan garem rait fo stap gud wea olketa garem kakai, kaliko, haus en babae hemi isi fo olketa nara help wea olketa bae needim.

folded.id: no hapen|lo|eni kaen or eni wan
folded.subject: no hapen
folded.object: eni kaen or eni wan

spans.text: No eni wan sapos fo hemi slev blo nara man, dis wan hemi baraba tambu fo duim en babae no hapen lo eni kaen or eni wan.

folded.id: nomata|lo|blo olketa seleva
folded.subject: nomata
folded.object: blo olketa seleva

spans.text: Evriwan bae savve go aot lo eni kantre, nomata lo blo olketa seleva, en olketa savve go baek lo kantre blo olketa.

folded.id: olketa elekson|wea|ikwol en fea nao i showem dis fala will
folded.subject: Olketa elekson
folded.object: ikwol en fea nao i showem dis fala will

spans.text: Olketa elekson wea ikwol en fea nao i showem dis fala will.

folded.id: olketa forcim|lo|hem
folded.subject: olketa forcim
folded.object: hem

spans.text: No eni wan bae hemi joinim eni asociasen bikos olketa forcim lo hem.

folded.subject: olketa provim
folded.object: olketa guilti

spans.text: Lo loa, evri wan wea olketa chargim wittim eni kriminol samting, kot mas lukim olketa olsem olketa inocen kasem taem olketa provim dat olketa guilti.

folded.id: olketa raits|ya|en friidoms
folded.subject: olketa raits
folded.object: en friidoms

spans.text: Fo mekem dis fala promis hemi waka, evri wan mas meanim en keepim olketa raits ya en friidoms.

spans.text: Olketa Stet wea memba blo United Nations tu i promis fo respectim en help supportim hiuman raits en olketa importen samting wea bae hemi givim friidom.

folded.id: olketa tingting|ya|hemi dea wea evri wan savve olsem hemi samting gud fo evri wan
folded.subject: Olketa tingting
folded.object: hemi dea wea evri wan savve olsem hemi samting gud fo evri wan

spans.text: Olketa tingting ya hemi dea wea evri wan savve olsem hemi samting gud fo evri wan.
Olketa samting ya nao mekem United Nations tingting strong fo buildim up en mek sua dat evri wan stap gud en frii.

folded.object: fo olketa mere hasban blo olketa die finis en eni wan moa wea garem kaen problem wea bae mekem olketa hard fo luk afta

folded.id: pis insaed|lo|dis fala wol
folded.subject: pis insaed
folded.object: dis fala wol

spans.text: Dis wan hemi givim fandasen fo friidom, jastis en pis insaed lo dis fala wol.

folded.id: practisim|or|preya lo siosi blo olketa en no frait fo som aot
folded.subject: practisim
folded.object: preya lo siosi blo olketa en no frait fo som aot

spans.text: Evri wan mas savve teachim, practisim or preya lo siosi blo olketa en no frait fo som aot.

folded.id: rait go|lo|olketa public service lo kantre blo olketa
folded.subject: rait go
folded.object: olketa public service lo kantre blo olketa

spans.text: Everiwan olketa garem semsem rait go lo olketa public service lo kantre blo olketa.

folded.id: samfala holide|wea|olketa stil tek pei
folded.subject: samfala holide
folded.object: olketa stil tek pei

spans.text: Evriwan garem rait fo relax en rest en fo garem samfala holide wea olketa stil tek pei, en olketa taem blo waka hemi sapos fo hemi ovam tumas.
